title: BAPL March Book Sale Coming Up - NewsBreak
text:
1 days ago The second Bethlehem Area Public Library book sale of 2026 is scheduled for March 18 from noon to 8 p.m. and March 21 from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. at the main branch, 11 West Church Street, in the ground floor book sale room. The usual array of books DVDs and music will be available for patrons to purchase. It’s an opportunity to shake off those winter doldrums and pick up some new reading as spring arrives. Most credit and debit cards are accepted. Additional information is available at bapl.org and 610-867-3761, ext. 235. Above: Bethlehem resident Karen Shaffer regularly attends the book sales looking for music, contemporary music in particular, as well as puzzles.Press photo by Dana Grubb. Read full article
